skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Hope Cruise
skins.content: Leonhardt's winter outfit / Hope Cruise. Made in Victorian fashion, featuring exquisite materials. Perfectly aligned while maintaining comfort to give an overall crisp look to the outfit - simple, yet not so simple.
skins.quote: On this day, the news he brings has nothing to do with Catastrophes. He carries only happiness and hope, and the gifts everyone dreamed of.

skins.name: Finder in the Rough
skins.content: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Finder in the Rough. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
skins.usage: One of Leonhardt's special work outfits.
skins.quote: As the wasteland wanderers say: when you find what you need to survive, you've found treasure.
